gecko.visible_surface_condition: micro-rough and textured with stitched seams and a snap button closure
evidence_used: pebbled texture of the synthetic leather surface
presence of folded seams and flap closure
gecko embodiment constraint: dry adhesion requires clean, dry, smooth, nonporous surfaces and degrades with roughness or interrupted contact
gecko.calculation_summary: F_normal = 0.0 N due to incompatibility (dry adhesion fails on textured/interrupted surfaces).
assumptions_and_uncertainty: The pebbled texture creates microscopic gaps preventing intimate contact required for van der Waals gecko adhesion.
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper relies on smooth, nonporous surfaces to establish intimate contact. The object exhibits a pebbled faux-leather texture and structural seams, which violate the surface requirements of dry adhesives, making the gecko gripper infeasible.

silicone.visible_surface_material: textured faux leather / pebbled synthetic polyurethane
silicone.visible_surface_condition: micro-rough and textured with a central snap button and printed logo
evidence_used: moderate size of the glasses case indicating a mass likely between 100g and 200g
high-friction silicone pad capable of engaging with textured surfaces
fin-ray compliant backing providing stable opposing sidewall contact
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated object mass ~ 0.15 kg. Required normal force estimated via heuristic friction scaling: F_normal = (m * g) / (2 * mu_eff) with estimated effective friction coefficient ~ 0.45, yielding approximately 3.2 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Exact mass of the case is unmeasured and estimated visually from typical scale.
Friction coefficient between silicone and faux leather is assumed to be moderate.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper uses friction and viscoelastic compliance rather than delicate dry adhesion. It can successfully conform to the textured faux leather surface of the glasses case. A moderate normal force of 3.2 N provides sufficient frictional grip against gravity for a standard lightweight glasses case without exceeding the 8 N actuator limit.

comparison_evidence: surface texture of the object is pebbled and textured rather than smooth and nonporous
gecko adhesion degrades rapidly on rough or textured surfaces, whereas silicone friction handles textured surfaces effectively
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction pad and compliant fin-ray structure can successfully grip the textured faux leather surface of the glasses case. The gecko gripper is infeasible due to the surface micro-roughness and texture, which prevent the intimate contact required for dry adhesion.
